title: Solar Site Survey Work Order Form
subtitle: An original solar site survey workflow that controls authorized field work from dispatch through return to service, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete solar site survey work order form for the proposed photovoltaic site that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a qualified crew receives a defined task and must preserve asset identity, work limits, energy-control references, as-found evidence, work performed, testing, exceptions, and operations handoff. The survey coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Solar site survey work order identity and dispatch
sections.guidance: Issue a traceable order with clear ownership, site contacts, and approved work limits.

sections.title: Solar site survey asset context, scope, and resources
sections.guidance: Match the order to the exact proposed photovoltaic site and define work that is included and excluded.

fields.label: Roof plane or ground area ID

blocks.label: Authorized task scope
items: Confirm property, service, and proposed array-area identity
Measure accessible roof plane or ground footprint
Map orientation, pitch, obstructions, and shade sources
Document roof covering and visible condition
Capture service, meter, and panel label evidence from safe access
Trace a non-invasive conceptual equipment and conduit route
Record access, staging, drainage, and maintenance constraints
Collect load-history and future-load references
Identify permitting, utility, and property-control dependencies
Prepare structural and electrical questions for qualified review

blocks.label: Scope, exclusions, parts, and completion criteria

fields.label: Approved work, explicit exclusions, required parts or tools, evidence expected, and completion criteria

sections.title: Solar site survey pre-work controls and authorization
sections.guidance: Do not begin intrusive work until hazards, system effects, isolation ownership, and test authority are explicit.

blocks.label: Pre-work authorization confirmations
items: Exact asset, boundaries, sources, and affected systems were identified
Site-specific procedure and applicable requirements were reviewed
Authorized and affected people, roles, and communications were confirmed
Electrical, mechanical, pressure, thermal, chemical, gravity, and stored energy were assessed
Isolation devices and personal or group controls remain under designated ownership
Stored or residual energy was controlled and verification evidence was recorded
Test or temporary re-energization steps and authority are explicit
Public, customer, traffic, environmental, and critical-load controls are in place

blocks.label: Energy-control and qualified-person boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not authorize roof access, structural conclusions, or contact with electrical components. Stop the survey when access, weather, damaged components, exposed conductors, or structural conditions are unsafe. Keep unqualified people clear and route the condition to the site's qualified electrical, structural, or safety reviewer. This work order records references and decisions; it does not replace the site's energy-control procedure. Unknown, changed, or reaccumulating energy is a stop condition until the designated authorized person re-establishes and verifies control.

sections.title: Solar site survey work execution and test evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually done, by whom, against which task, and with what result.

blocks.label: As-left readings and test results
blocks.guidance: Record method, instrument, operating state, and acceptance reference in linked evidence when needed.

fields.label: Unexpected conditions, approved changes, temporary measures, test context, and evidence links

sections.title: Solar site survey exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Unprotected roof edge, unstable ladder, or unsafe access
Wet, damaged, loose, or storm-affected roof or PV components
Exposed conductors, open electrical parts, arcing, or burn marks
Structural movement, severe deterioration, or falling-object exposure
High wind, lightning, ice, heat, or other unsafe weather
Unknown energized equipment or damaged wiring pathway
Blocked emergency access or uncontrolled public exposure
Any condition beyond the surveyor's authorization or training
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This record does not authorize roof access, structural conclusions, or contact with electrical components. Stop the survey when access, weather, damaged components, exposed conductors, or structural conditions are unsafe. Keep unqualified people clear and route the condition to the site's qualified electrical, structural, or safety reviewer.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each work order exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Solar site survey decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Proposed photovoltaic site identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
